premise.claim: spec.runAfter is mutable, so a user can remove it while the operation is still waiting; reconcileOperationDataFlow then dereferences the nil runAfter (runAfter.Namespace) and panics; Fluid does not enable controller-runtime's RecoverPanic, so the panic kills dataset-controller, which crash-loops and stops Dataset and data-operation reconciliation for the whole cluster.
premise.evidence: Harness grafted onto merge-base f432bdc8: all 6 subtests fail with 'runtime error: invalid memory address or nil pointer dereference' (results/base-harness.txt); same tests pass on head cc3947c0 (results/head-harness.txt). The PR's own tests on base: 35 Passed | 6 Failed, all nil-pointer (results/base-pr-tests.txt).

liveNote: L3 (not run this round, no cluster): the PR's own e2e verify_dataload_runafter_removed in test/gha-e2e/curvine/test.sh covers it on a kind cluster; check DataLoad reaches Complete within 180s of removing spec.runAfter and dataset-controller restart count stays unchanged.
